request: Analyze GSE239596 for PMID 39413782 (Vagal sensory neuron-derived FGF3 controls insulin secretion.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk total RNA-seq (Takara Pico-Input), Illumina HiSeq 2000, mouse jugular-nodose ganglia (JNG)
final.sample_inclusion: 6-week-old C57BL/6J male mice, n=3 PBS (vehicle) and n=3 S961 (insulin receptor antagonist, 10 nmol/week, osmotic pump, 2 weeks); JNG harvested (S2.1.p1, S4.2.2.p1)
final.primary_estimand: Effect of S961-induced acute insulin resistance (vs PBS vehicle) on JNG gene expression. No exercise, training or physical-activity intervention exists in the sequenced experiment; 'physical activity' in the paper is a CLAMS phenotype readout of AAV-FGF3 mice (S2.2.p1), and exercise is mentioned only in Discussion (S3.p2).
planned_contrasts: S961 vs PBS (S2.1.p1; paper: 90 DEGs, 66 up / 24 down, FDR < 0.05)
final.paper_method: DESeq2 Wald test (S4.3.2.p1); GEO data_processing instead states edgeR glmQLFTest
final.paper_results: 90 DEGs (66 up, 24 down) S961 vs PBS; Fgf3 log2(S961/PBS) ~ 3.6 (S2.1.p1, Table S2)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: The only sequenced comparison is S961 vs PBS in vagal ganglia (S2.1.p1, S4.2.2.p1, FIG1). The data statement S4.1.3.p1 names GSE239596 for this RNA-seq. No exercise arm is described anywhere in Results or Methods; the AAV-FGF3 'physical activity' readouts (S2.2.p1, FIG2W) are locomotor counts in CLAMS, not an exercise intervention, and are not sequenced.

checks: C57BL/6J male, S961/PBS osmotic pump protocol in treatment_protocol_ch1 matches S4.2.2.p1

ownership.reasoning: Accession, sample count, protocol and cell type match the paper's JNG RNA-seq. Matrix is the merged per-sample exonic read-count files from GSE239596_RAW.tar.

alignment.reasoning: Tar columns are GSM<id>_NG_<Ctrl|Treat><n>_exonic_gene; the GSM prefix equals the metadata index. Group comes from title (Ctrl = PBS vehicle, Treat = S961, per S2.1.p1). characteristics treatment is 'S961' for all six samples, so it cannot be used for grouping.

matrix.reasoning: integer_fraction 1.0, max 1.5e6, median 8; data_processing: 'raw read count values for each sample' from a Perl exon counter after STAR; paper input is the raw read count table (S4.3.2.p1).

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast: the only sequenced groups are PBS vehicle vs S961 insulin-receptor antagonist in vagal ganglia (S2.1.p1, S4.2.2.p1). No exercise/training arm exists in the paper or GEO metadata, so the requested exercise estimand cannot be identified. Relabeling S961 as exercise would manufacture a contrast.

candidates.reason_rejected: valid paper contrast but it measures pharmacological insulin resistance, not exercise; outside the requested estimand

design.reasoning: Request asks how exercise affects gene expression. The paper's sequencing experiment is S961 vs PBS; exercise appears only as a Discussion remark (S3.p2) and physical activity only as a CLAMS phenotype of unsequenced AAV-FGF3 mice (S2.2.p1, FIG2W).

discrepancies.data: characteristics tissue and source_name = 'spinal cord'; cell type = jugular-nodose ganglia
discrepancies.disposition: recorded; GEO annotation error, does not change sample identity

discrepancies.data: characteristics treatment = 'S961' for all 6 samples; titles split Ctrl/Treat

discrepancies.disposition: recorded; moot because the case stops at design
